name: IT Cases Closed This Month
query:
SELECT
    i.case_owner, 
    u.full_name AS "Owner Name",
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Client Call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Client Call",
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Issues' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Issues,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Tasks' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tasks",
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Information' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Information,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Virtual Install Call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Virtual Install Call',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Change Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Change Request',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Product Innovation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Product Innovation',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Remove Vend' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Remove Vend',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Sales Support' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Sales Support',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Salesforce' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Salesforce',
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason = 'Travel Install' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Travel Install',
    i.subject AS Subject
FROM
    `tabIssue` i
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    issue_type = 'IT'
    AND YEAR(i.date_and_time_closed) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    AND MONTH(i.date_and_time_closed) = MONTH(CURDATE())

GROUP BY
    i.case_owner, u.full_name
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.case_reason IN ('Change Request', 'Client Call', 'Information', 'Issues', 'Product Innovation', 'Remove Vend', 'Sales Support', 'Salesforce', 'Tasks', 'Travel Install', 'Virtual Install Call') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
